name: Telegram RAG Bot — Chat Logging (Text, Image, Document)

parameters.text:
=You are screening an image shared in a job/gig-work Telegram group to classify what kind of payment-related image it is, if any.

Message caption/text from the poster, if any (use ONLY to help identify a paying company or payment method not visible in the image itself — never invent one): "{{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.caption ?? '' }}"

=== ONLY DIRECT PROOF COUNTS ===
Direct proof is any of:
(a) a screenshot of an actual payment/banking app or wallet showing the transaction itself,
(b) an email or in-app receipt showing transaction details,
(c) a payout/earnings notification sent DIRECTLY BY the platform or employer to the recipient — e.g. "Your payout of $X is on its way", a payslip-style email, an app notification stating an amount and status. This still counts as direct proof even if the same email/message ALSO contains unrelated marketing, referral-program, or cross-sell content (e.g. "Earn more through referrals", an "Explore" button) elsewhere in the message — ignore that marketing portion and extract only from the actual payout notice,
(d) a bot-generated notification card from THIS group's own bot (headers like "INVOICE / BILL" or "VERIFIED PAYMENT").

If the image is instead a screenshot of a social media post, chat message, or forum thread that merely TALKS ABOUT or DISPLAYS a payment as part of a longer post — recognizable by social-platform UI chrome such as: an avatar + username + "Follow"/role-badge header, like/comment/share/bookmark counts, a post-age label ("8h", "22h", "2d"), a "Translate" option, "View activity", or nested reply/comment threads — this is a REPOST/TESTIMONIAL, not direct proof, even if it contains a visible amount, a "successful"/"completed" status, or persuasive claims about earnings. Set Category to "not_payment" in this case, regardless of what payment-looking content is embedded inside it.

=== PRODUCT / COURSE LISTINGS ARE NOT PAYMENTS ===
An ad or storefront-style listing for a course, ebook, service, or product (price/currency badge next to a product title or thumbnail, "buy now"-style layout, with NO transaction status and NO invoice framing directed at a specific buyer) is NOT a payment screenshot — set Category to "not_payment" even though a price/currency amount is visible.

Set Category to exactly one of:
- "paid": a completed payout/transfer, shown as DIRECT proof (see above) — status wording like "Completed", "Successful", "Sent", "Submitted", "Penarikan sukses" all count.
- "pending": a payout/payment shown as DIRECT proof that is scheduled, processing, in transit, or awaiting approval — not yet completed/arrived. Includes payout notification emails saying funds are "on its way" or "should appear within X business days".
- "bill_invoice": an invoice, bill, or payment request shown as DIRECT proof — money owed, not money received. Includes course/product purchase cards explicitly framed as an invoice/bill.
- "not_payment": the image isn't direct payment/financial proof — including product/course/service ads, storefront listings, and social-media/chat reposts or testimonials that merely display or discuss a payment.
- "other": something payment-related that doesn't fit the above.

Regardless of Category, extract whatever of the following is visible — don't leave fields empty just because Category isn't "paid":
- Paying_Company: the employer, client, or company the money is coming FROM (or billed BY, for invoices), if named. Empty string if not shown.
- Amount: the amount AND currency combined into one string, currency placed where it naturally belongs (e.g. "USDC 99.34", "$1,XXX.XX", "USD X53.47"). If digits are blurred/covered/blacked-out/scribbled, replace each hidden digit with X following normal digit grouping — a hidden group after a thousands comma is exactly 3 X's (e.g. "$1,XXX", never "$1,X"), a hidden cents group after a decimal point is exactly 2 X's (e.g. "$1,XXX.XX"). If the whole amount is hidden, write "redacted". Empty string only if no amount appears anywhere.
- Date: a date/time that is part of the PAYMENT CONTENT itself — e.g. "sent on...", an issue date, a due date, a transaction timestamp inside the message or receipt body. Do NOT use timestamps from surrounding UI chrome that aren't part of the payment content — an email/inbox app's "received at" time, the phone's status bar clock, a notification badge time, a social post's "Xh" age label, etc. If the payment content itself doesn't state a date, leave this empty — don't substitute a nearby UI timestamp. The date format should look like 1 January 2026.
- Payment_Method: whatever best identifies how/where the money moved or is billed through — a processor/app/bank name (Airtm, PayPal, Deel, Wise, a bank name) OR a generic method (Bank Transfer, Wire, Crypto) if no named service is shown. Use whichever is actually visible; don't guess a name that isn't there. If nothing is visible in the image, check the caption text above before leaving this empty.

Respond with ONLY a single valid JSON object, no markdown, no code fences, no commentary, matching exactly:
{
  "Category": string,
  "Paying_Company": string,
  "Amount": string,
  "Date": string,
  "Payment_Method": string
}

=Describe this image in a single continuous paragraph of plain prose — no bullet points, numbered lists, markdown, or headers, and no introductory phrases like "This image shows" or "The image depicts". Open directly with the subject matter.

Treat this as an OCR-plus-context task: transcribe every piece of visible text exactly as written (titles, axis/column labels, category names, numeric values, units, source or attribution lines, watermarks), preserving Indonesian number formatting (e.g. "." as thousands separator) rather than reformatting or rounding. Where a label is paired with a value (a category next to a bar, a row in a table), keep that pairing intact and state them together, and preserve the order and grouping shown in the image (e.g. left column before right column, top to bottom) rather than mixing them up. If the image contains many similar rows (a long list of regions or categories with values), transcribe all of them once each, in order — do not summarize a long list down to a few examples, but also never repeat an item or a block of items you've already stated. If incidental UI chrome is visible (a browser button, a "Close" button, a cursor, a watermark unrelated to the content) mention it only in passing if at all, and don't let it interrupt the flow of the actual content.

After transcribing the text, briefly state in your own words what the image is illustrating or comparing, so the paragraph conveys both what is written and what it means. Write in full sentences, and make sure your final sentence is complete — do not trail off or cut the description short partway through a thought or list.

If a caption is provided below, use it only to clarify who/what is shown (e.g. resolve ambiguity) — do not quote or repeat it, and do not let it override what's actually visible in the image.

Caption from sender: {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.caption ? $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.caption : 'None' }}

Extract all readable text from this PDF document, preserving structure and reading order.

First output this header block:
Title: [document title, or "Untitled" if none is visible]
Document Type: [journal article / research paper / report / news article / invoice / form / presentation / other]
Language: [primary language(s) detected]

Then extract the full body text:
- Preserve original reading order, headings, and section breaks.
- Transcribe body text exactly as it appears. Do not paraphrase, summarize, or invent content.
- For any table, chart, or diagram, insert a brief plain-language explanation of what it shows, placed inline at the point where it appears (not moved elsewhere), wrapped as [Table/Figure: explanation]. This is the one place paraphrasing is allowed.
- If any part is illegible or unclear, mark it as [illegible] rather than guessing.

Return ONLY the header block and the extracted text. Do not add conversational filler, summaries, or intro/outro text.
=Mohon maaf, tipe file yang Anda kirim belum dapat disimpan ke database. Error: File extention is not supported. Only support DOCX, XML, YML, XLSX, CSV, PDF, TXT, PPTX, HTML files.
=Mohon maaf, file dokumen belum dapat terbaca. Silakan coba lagi! Error: The generated content was filtered because it may contain material that resembles existing copyrighted works.
